bibliographic-data.invention-title: AUSGANGSMATERIAL ZUR EXTRUSION UND VERWENDUNGEN DAVON
CHARGE D'ALIMENTATION POUR EXTRUSION ET SES UTILISATIONS
PROCESS FOR 3D PRINTING, USE OF A SUSPENSION FOR 3D-PRINTING AND A 3D-PRINTER

abstract.p: The present invention relates to a suspension comprising 50-95% by weight of the total suspension (w/w) of at least one ceramic material and at least 5% by weight of the total suspension of one or more fatty acids or derivatives thereof. In addition, the invention relates to uses of such suspension in extrusion processes.
